sources.label: Morphe patches for Anghami
sources.author: Anghami patches by Nady
patch_list: AMOLED black background
Forces pure-black app background in dark mode (window_background_color -> #000000). Surfaces/cards keep stock greys; light mode untouched.
Disable audio ads
Forces AdSettings.noAd=true and PlayQueue.getDisableAds=true so songs are treated as ad-free locally. Client flag only.
Header Play + Shuffle
Playlist/album headers show Play + Shuffle instead of Shuffle + Edit/Follow/Like (functional LEAVECOLLAB, local-songs ADD_MORE and podcasts untouched). Pulls in 'Unforce shuffle'.
Hide Gold features
Forces Account.isGold/isGoldUser and all GoldUtilsKt.isGold overloads to false. Hides server-gated Gold UI instead of spoofing it.
Hide shuffle badges
Hides PLAYS IN SHUFFLE badges on playlist/album headers, feed cards, and rows. Cosmetic only.
Hide upgrade upsell
Hides the nav upgrade entry, header promo banner, feed upsell cards and AI MIX button model (gap-free), and settings subscribe banner. Server-driven UI the Plus spoof cannot remove.
Hide upsell feature buttons
Hides TRY SING ALONG karaoke upsell, disables the karaoke feature itself, and hides the player/playlist AI MIX buttons. Feature UI stays hidden rather than paywalled.
LRCLIB lyrics fallback
When the server returns truncated/empty lyrics, fetches the full text from LRCLIB (opt-in free source) into a separate cache. Native full lyrics and the Plus path are untouched.
Lyrics options on play long-press
Long-press play/pause for lyrics options (retry, LRCLIB search, synced/plain toggle, server version) instead of the sleep timer. Pulls in 'LRCLIB lyrics fallback'.
Monet dynamic colors
Replaces the static neon brand accents with wallpaper-based Monet dynamic colors (M3 Expressive primary/secondary/tertiary roles) on Android 12+. Older versions keep stock colors.
Player theme

Night-only player theme: removes the cover-art tint and paints the now-playing row, pills and action icons with the primary accent at night; day mode keeps the stock tinted player. Pulls in 'Player theme background' resources.
Player theme background
Makes the player background, text, icons and seekbar follow the app's day/night theme. Keeps the darker split below the progress bar. Pair with 'Player theme'.
Remove popup promos
No-ops the in-house popup funnel, the fullscreen startup dialog, and the flyer ad callback. Google SDK ads untouched.
Spoof stock app signature
Forces SignatureUtils.getAppSignature to hash with the stock cert prefix (he9B...kw=), so X-ANGH-APP-RGSIG matches a stock install. Salt/body hashing unchanged.
Unforce shuffle

Forces server shuffleOn=false at both sync points, never reports shuffle to the server, disables the pick-a-song radio redirect, enables shuffle buttons, and disarms the shuffle upsell dialog. Manual shuffle toggle and the header Shuffle b…
Unlock downloads
No-ops download limit asserts, forces limited-plan=false and large offline caps (999999). Local gates only; the server still authorizes files.
Unlock local Plus
Forces Account.isPlus/isPlusUser=true, enablePlayerRestrictions=false, canPlayOfflineAndFree=true. Local UI/gating only; server premium checks remain.
Unlock playback limits
Disables skip and queue limits (skipLimitReached/queueRestrictionsEnabled=false, disable-flags=true). Local gates only.

sources.author: Kero309x
patch_list: Allow screenshots
Stops the player, the live radio screen and the main screen from marking their windows as secure, so screenshots and screen recording capture them.
Block ads between tracks
Stops the player from inserting audio and video advertisements between tracks.
Block promotional popups
Stops the popup and full-screen promotional overlays from being drawn over the app.
Disable analytics
Stops the app starting its analytics, attribution and crash reporting SDKs and sending events to them.
Disable first-party Silo telemetry
Stops the application reporting playback, navigation and device data to Anghami's own Silo telemetry.
Disable forced shuffle
Plays a list in its own order instead of turning it into a shuffled radio queue for accounts without Plus.
Disable the rating prompt
Stops Anghami from asking you to rate the app, in both its own dialog and the Play review sheet.
Hide Gold upsell
Hides the Gold call to action that section headers can show.
Hide in-feed ad banners
Stops lists from inserting advertising banners between their cells.
Hide premium feature buttons
Stops the player and the queue rows from drawing the karaoke upsell button.
Hide shuffle badges
Stops list cards, rows and headers from drawing the badge that marks shuffled playback.
Hide sponsored content
Removes the sponsored label from song rows and cards, and the sponsor banner from the in-car screen.
Hide upgrade banners
Removes the navigation entry, promo bar, feed cells, downloads notice and settings or library rows that advertise a subscription upgrade.
Ignore the forced update requirement
Stops the client from showing the blocking update dialog when the server marks this build as outdated.
Lift download limits
Stops the client refusing downloads because of the plan check, the collection restriction or the offline count.
Plus entitlement state
Reports the account as a paying subscriber to every local check that derives that state.
Show profile Plus badge
Draws the subscription badge on your own profile and on the account row without changing what the account is entitled to.
Stock signature assertion
Derives the request signature from the store build's certificate instead of the installed one.
Unlimited track skips
Removes the client-side limit on skipping tracks.
Unlock lyrics
Opens the lyrics screen for every account instead of showing the subscription prompt.
